dependencies.note: The entire pipeline (calibration_synthetic.py, build_isogeny_graph.py, descent_hitting_time.py) uses only the Python standard library. No numpy/scipy/sage dependency, unlike EXP-SSIQ-4de240 (which needed numpy for its C-NULL lattice surrogate). This was a deliberate implementation choice to keep the Fp2 field arithmetic and OLS fit fully auditable in pure Python and bit-reproducible without a floating-point-library-version confound.

resource_caps_applied.note: spec budget: wall_clock_seconds_per_run=7200, maximum_memory_gb=4. Neither cap was hit; actual wall clock was ~37.5s.
